summary: Telix Pharmaceuticals Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC attaching a press release announcing the settlement of US$600M convertible bonds. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer communicating a completed financing event. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisors, structural mechanics, or regulatory clock are provided. This is not a special situation such as a tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or capital return event. The settlement of convertible bonds is a routine corporate action and does not trigger a special-situation classification. What to watch: no further risk-arb angle here.
